entries.description: Well-formed fixture: a card carrying its closing 'What could not be checked' section, and a CSV whose every row has the same number of cells as its header. Proves the linter raises no false alarms.

entries.rule: CSV row cell count differs from the header
entries.description: One deliberately spaced CSV row so its cell count differs from the header. The linter must name the offending row and both counts (row cells versus header cells).

entries.rule: card missing the closing 'What could not be checked' section
entries.description: A README card with no closing 'What could not be checked' section. The linter must flag the missing section by name.
